target.title: fix(exec): require approval for OpenClaw lifecycle commands
target.body:
Fixes #99518

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where users running exec commands through gateway or node hosts could have OpenClaw gateway/daemon lifecycle mutations handled by normal allowlist or auto-review paths when the command should require explicit approval.

The affected workflow is OpenClaw self-management from exec surfaces: stopping, starting, restarting, running, deleting, or uninstalling the gateway/daemon through CLI, launchctl, systemctl, schtasks, process-kill, shell-wrapper, package-manager, or Windows shim commands.

## Why This Change Was Made

This adds a focused lifecycle classifier to the exec approval policy and wires it into both gateway-host and node-host approval analysis. The guard forces explicit approval for OpenClaw lifecycle mutations unless exec is already in yolo mode (`security=full`, `ask=off`).

Read-only lifecycle inspection remains outside the guard, including `openclaw gateway status`, `launchctl print`, `systemctl status`, `schtasks /Query`, and `pidof openclaw`.

## User Impact

Operators get an extra human confirmation before an agent or auto-review path can stop, start, restart, run, delete, or uninstall the OpenClaw gateway/daemon in non-yolo configurations. Existing yolo-mode behavior and read-only status/query commands are unchanged.

## Evidence

Focused tests:

```shell
node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/infra/exec-approvals-policy.test.ts --testNamePattern="OpenClaw lifecycle"
# Test Files  1 passed (1)
# Tests  29 passed | 77 skipped (106)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.test.ts --testNamePattern="OpenClaw lifecycle"
# Test Files  1 passed (1)
# Tests  3 passed | 53 skipped (56)

node scripts/run-vitest.mjs src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-node.test.ts --testNamePattern="OpenClaw lifecycle"
# Test Files  1 passed (1)
# Tests  1 passed | 48 skipped (49)
```

Static checks:

```shell
pnpm exec oxlint src/infra/exec-approvals.ts src/infra/exec-approvals-policy.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-gateway.test.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-node.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-node-phases.ts src/agents/bash-tools.exec-host-node.test.ts
# passed

git diff --check
# passed
```

Additional local probe:

```shell
# commandRequiresOpenClawLifecycleApproval returned true for:
# - cmd.exe /d /s /c "schtasks /Run /TN \"OpenClaw Gateway\""
# - powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "openclaw gateway restart"
# - pwsh -Command "systemctl --user restart openclaw-gateway.service"
# and false for read-only cmd/powershell status/query forms.
```

Autoreview:

```shell
python .agents\skills\autoreview\scripts\autoreview --mode local --no-web-search
```

Earlier autoreview passes found concrete missing lifecycle forms (`systemctl start`, `launchctl bootstrap`, Windows shims, `schtasks`, `corepack pnpm`, and `openclaw.mjs`/`node openclaw.mjs` entrypoints). This PR incorporates fixes and regression coverage for those forms. The final clean rerun is currently blocked by the local Codex review subprocess usage limit, which reports: `You've hit your usage limit ... try again at 8:19 PM` even after the indicated retry time.
